supersedes.reason: The v1 candidate checked only startup and exited-child recovery. It did not continuously re-run the exact health contract or recover a live-but-silent observer.

problem_statement: The SP500 and SPCX report-only observers can exit or remain alive while their status stops advancing after backend startup. The startup guard does not recover either post-start failure, leaving executable index routes technically unavailable while the order backend remains healthy.

verification.file_limit: all five code and test files at or below 500 lines
verification.function_limit: all functions at or below 50 lines

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: A standalone zero-authority supervisor can recover one exited index observer without restarting its healthy sibling or altering durable prospective evidence.
hypothesis_ledger.falsifier: Any crash recovery that regresses a cursor, replaces a journal, emits retroactive evidence, starts a duplicate owner, or restarts the healthy sibling.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The same supervisor can detect and replace an alive-but-silent observer without treating process liveness as data health.
hypothesis_ledger.falsifier: A child status older than 20 seconds remains owned without restart, consumes a separate restart budget, or causes the fresh sibling to restart.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The supervisor candidate is safe to deploy automatically during the current live run.
hypothesis_ledger.falsifier: Deployment changes process topology and requires an approved controlled handoff plus a prospective soak with no duplicated decisions.

change_proposal.1_recommendation: At an explicitly approved controlled boundary, stop only the two current manual unsigned observers and replace them with the singleton report-only supervisor. Do not restart or alter the v51 order backend.
change_proposal.2_why_now: A prior approximately 2.5-hour observer outage made both live index routes technically unavailable despite a healthy backend; process liveness alone also cannot prove fresh observer output.
change_proposal.3_evidence_reviewed: Incident journal, live observer status/cursor/journals, process identities, public source candles, backend heartbeat and route telemetry, deterministic exit and silence recovery tests, and fresh runtime reconciliation.
change_proposal.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: Post-start observer exit or silence is not recovered automatically and currently depends on manual detection and restart.
change_proposal.5_applicable_market_regime: All regimes; this is market-data process availability, not a trading-signal rule.
6_alternatives_considered: retain manual observers and alerts only
embed collection inside the order backend
change_proposal.7_proposed_live_change: Process-topology change only: replace two manually started unsigned observer processes with one singleton parent managing the same exact commands and durable state files. No asset, strategy, signal, exit, sizing, leverage, margin, stop, or order-client change.
change_proposal.8_expected_upside: Reduce silent index-route downtime while retaining fail-closed provider behavior and durable prospective evidence.
change_proposal.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Duplicate writers, cursor regression, journal replacement, restart storms, stale status, persistent upstream failure, supervisor termination, or a restart during a partially written status. Tests cover deterministic boundaries; real-process soak remains outstanding.
change_proposal.10_validation_completed: 55 relevant tests pass; exited and silent child recovery are fail-closed and sibling-preserving; status distinguishes warming, ready, stopped, and fault; source has no order surface; current live processes were unchanged.
change_proposal.11_validation_still_required: Controlled prospective soak after approval, checkpoint/TUI visibility for supervisor status, and a real killed/silent-child exercise proving one restart with no duplicated decisions.
change_proposal.12_success_metrics: Zero cursor regression or duplicate decision; no signer/order surface; failed or silent child restarts within the bounded policy; healthy sibling PID remains unchanged; checkpoint and TUI expose current observer readiness or fault.
change_proposal.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any duplicate owner, cursor or journal mutation, retroactive decision, wrong symbol identity, restart-budget exhaustion, unexpected execution authority, or backend interference. Roll back by stopping the supervisor and manually starting the exact observers from preserved cursors.
change_proposal.14_confidence_level: High for deterministic isolation and fail-closed recovery; medium for operational reliability until a prospective soak and checkpoint/TUI integration are validated.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Continue exact source-native SPCX v3 long-and-short lifecycle collection, then SP500; BRENTOIL live-canary execution priors remain assigned to the separate oil-lane comparison.
